messages:
nina: Quick chase: INC-2026-58 postmortem had 4 remediation items. Three still open and one unassigned. This thread to consolidate owners + ETAs. Please reply with owner + date by EOD today.

sam: I own the DB schema migration item. Blocked on schema review from infra team; ETA Thu AM if review happens today.

remediation-bot: Automated reminder: 3 open remediation items for INC-2026-58. Use `/remediate assign <item> @user YYYY-MM-DD` to set owner+ETA.

leo: I'm on autoscaler tuning. I started the new threshold experiments; preliminary results show oscillation at 95th-percentile load. Need one more test run, ETA Fri COB.

nina: Thanks. Leo, can you add the experiment logs to the postmortem and link the dashboard? Also tag the item as `recurring-pattern` — we saw similar symptoms in INC-2026-22 and INC-2026-33.

sre-lead: Noted on recurrence. Ops: please create a short-term alert with a suppression window to avoid noisy alerts during rollout. Who will add the alert?

leo: I'll add the alert rule after the final test run. Will include suppression and a playbook snippet.

nina: Still one unassigned item: "improve end-to-end request tracing". It's been sitting unassigned for 52 days. If nobody claims by tomorrow I'll reassign to oncall rotation and escalate.

sam: I can take tracing but need access to the tracing-prod project. @sre-lead could you grant `tracing:write`? ETA next Tue for a minimal trace propagation fix.

sre-lead: Granted to @sam. Please file a small RFC or PR so we can review change impact.

nina: Good. Reminder: closure criteria from postmortem — (a) PR/patch merged or rollback plan in place, (b) postmortem updated with owner+ETA, (c) monitoring added and 2-week follow-up scheduled. No item should be marked resolved without all three.

remediation-bot: Escalation schedule: 48h until first escalation -> will notify `eng-vp` and `oncall-manager` if any item lacks owner or ETA.

sam: Linking the draft PR: https://git.internal/r/5678 — tests currently failing on cross-region trace headers. Error snippet below.

```
ERROR: trace header truncated in proxy
service/proxy/trace.go:88
```

leo: I can help debug the header trimming, seen it happen when proxy rewrites exceed 8KB header limit.

eng-vp: Thanks for the ping. If owners are not responsive by the escalation timer, we'll reassign and follow up with team leads. Keep me in the loop.

nina: I'll post an update here after the noon check-in tomorrow. If anyone needs me to nudge a specific manager earlier, DM me.

sre-lead: Adding one operational note: because this pattern repeated across incidents, let's consider bundling the mitigations into a single cross-team epic so it doesn't slip through. I'll open an epic and tag all related RCAs.

nina: Prefer that. Closing ask for now: owners to confirm ETA in this thread. We'll reconvene when PRs land or on escalation. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
